def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    templates=[]
    for row in grid:
        seq=[v for v in row if v]
        if len(seq)>1: templates.append(seq)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        if sum(v!=0 for v in row)>1: continue
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v:
                # Prefer the template whose colors most specifically identify this anchor.
                candidates=[s for s in templates if v in s]
                if not candidates: continue
                seq=min(candidates,key=lambda s:(sum(v in t for t in templates),-len(s)))
                start=c-seq.index(v)
                for j,x in enumerate(seq):
                    if 0<=start+j<w: out[r][start+j]=x
    return out
PY
